related.title: HTR-PM 高溫氣冷發電系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「負載追隨的升降載速率」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；HTR-PM 高溫氣冷發電系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Ramp rate in load following" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of HTR-PM high-temperature gas-cooled generation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦為工業供熱設計的球床高溫氣冷模組：包覆顆粒燃料、製程蒸汽、負載追隨與氦氣補充；HTR-PM 高溫氣冷發電系統則以球床式高溫氣冷堆的定量檢核：氦氣流量、單球功率、餘熱被動導出與燃料球循環為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A pebble-bed gas-cooled module designed for industrial heat: coated-particle fuel, process steam, load following and helium make-up; HTR-PM high-temperature gas-cooled generation centres on quantitative checks of a pebble-bed high-temperature reactor: helium flow, power per pebble, passive decay-heat removal and pebble circulation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「氦氣的洩漏與年補充量」的模型移到HTR-PM 高溫氣冷發電系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「喪失冷卻試驗與餘熱被動導出」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "Helium leakage and annual make-up" to HTR-PM high-temperature gas-cooled generation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "The loss-of-cooling test and passive decay-heat removal", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「負載追隨的升降載速率」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；HTR-PM 高溫氣冷發電系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Ramp rate in load following" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of HTR-PM high-temperature gas-cooled generation must be respecified.

related.title: Kairos Hermes 氟鹽冷卻試驗堆
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「負載追隨的升降載速率」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；Kairos Hermes 氟鹽冷卻試驗堆的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Ramp rate in load following" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Kairos Hermes Fluoride-Salt-Cooled Test Reactor must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦為工業供熱設計的球床高溫氣冷模組：包覆顆粒燃料、製程蒸汽、負載追隨與氦氣補充；Kairos Hermes 氟鹽冷卻試驗堆則以氟鹽冷卻的球床試驗堆：熔鹽的體積熱容量、流量、會浮起來的燃料球與凝固餘裕為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A pebble-bed gas-cooled module designed for industrial heat: coated-particle fuel, process steam, load following and helium make-up; Kairos Hermes Fluoride-Salt-Cooled Test Reactor centres on A fluoride-salt-cooled pebble-bed test reactor: volumetric heat capacity of the salt, flow, pebbles that float and freezing margin, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「氟鹽的體積熱容量」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「氦氣的洩漏與年補充量」的模型移到Kairos Hermes 氟鹽冷卻試驗堆，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Volumetric heat capacity of fluoride salt".
Move the model of "Helium leakage and annual make-up" to Kairos Hermes Fluoride-Salt-Cooled Test Reactor, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「負載追隨的升降載速率」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；Kairos Hermes 氟鹽冷卻試驗堆的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Ramp rate in load following" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Kairos Hermes Fluoride-Salt-Cooled Test Reactor must be respecified.
